name: Lightning Arrow

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit or miss a target with a ranged attack using a weapon.

targets.description: the target of your ranged weapon attack

summary: After a ranged weapon attack: 4d8 Lightning to the target (half on a miss), then 2d8 to creatures within 10 ft (Dex save, half).
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit or miss a target with a ranged attack using a weapon. The weapon or ammunition turns into a bolt of lightning: instead of the attack's usual damage and effects, the target takes 4d8 Lightning damage on a hit, or half as much on a miss. Then each creature within 10 feet of the target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The weapon or ammunition then returns to its normal form. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: both the 4d8 and the 2d8 increase by 1d8 for each slot level above 3.
